requirements_summary: Stonehaven needs Hosted API with OpenAI-compat mode for a low-friction POC. Target metrics: chat p95 < 300ms (cache hit), embedding latency < 50ms median for 768-dim vectors, cost reduction target 20%+ vs current OpenAI spend, SSO and audit logs enabled, EU data residency for specific customers. Dedicated sizing: estimate 2x 80GB GPUs for baseline expected QPS 150 concurrent sessions with KV cache enabled. Must support streaming + function calling parity. Automated eval harness required to surface regressions during rollout.
po\u0441_plan_summary: (POC) 6 weeks: week 0-1 ingest eval dataset & baseline metrics on OpenAI; week 2 deploy OpenAI-compat shim to Redwood Hosted; week 3 run A/B traffic + automated evals; week 4 tuning and prompt parity fixes; week 5 scale load test to Dedicated-equivalent throughput; week 6 review and contract-sizing. Success criteria: no >5% drop in support resolution rate, embedding cosine similarity >0.98 average for top-k, acceptable latency delta (<20% increase) and 20%+ cost improvement for embeddings.
commercial_notes: Asked for 12-month committed pricing scenarios for Dedicated with burst buffer; provided three tiers in pricing deck. Procurement wants monthly vs annual comparison. Legal asked for SOC2 Type II report copy and DPA with EU data processing appendix.
